Mankey

Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Mankey is a Fighting-type Pig Monkey Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 28 kg. It evolves into Primeape. Its highest base stat is Attack (80), with a base stat total of 305.
